upg12:0.1: Verses about a Lion of a Man
upg12:1.1: Having beautiful feet marked with a fine wheel,
upg12:1.2: his long heels are a characteristic mark,
upg12:1.3: his feet decorated with chowrie and sunshade,
upg12:1.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:2.1: An excellent and graceful Sakyan prince,
upg12:2.2: with a body full of characteristic marks,
upg12:2.3: a hero who has come for the world’s benefit,
upg12:2.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:3.1: Just like the full moon is his beautiful face,
upg12:3.2: dear to gods and men, a Nāga amongst men,
upg12:3.3: walking like a charming lord of elephants,
upg12:3.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:4.1: Born into a leading noble family,
upg12:4.2: gods and men revere his feet,
upg12:4.3: having virtue and concentration established in his mind,
upg12:4.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:5.1: Having a long, prominent and well-formed nose,
upg12:5.2: cow-like eyelashes, beautiful deep black eyes,
upg12:5.3: his deep black eyebrows (are just like) Indra’s bow,
upg12:5.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:6.1: Having a round, sizeable, and well-formed neck,
upg12:6.2: a lion’s jaw, a body like the king of beasts,
upg12:6.3: beautiful golden skin, of supreme colour,
upg12:6.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:7.1: Having a very deep, charming, and sweet voice,
upg12:7.2: with a beautiful tongue, red like vermillion,
upg12:7.3: with twenty by twenty beautiful white teeth,
upg12:7.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:8.2: a forehead like a plate of purified gold,
upg12:8.3: and hair between the brows like a pure white star,
upg12:8.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
upg12:9.1: Like the moon going along the dark night path,
upg12:9.2: surrounded by a body of stars,
upg12:9.3: is the Lord of Ascetics in the midst of his disciples,
upg12:9.4: that indeed is your father, a lion of a man.
